neutral_common: Use case: illustration-story. Production asset for Sound Stars children's learning app. One isolated mascot, transparent background, square 1024x1024 canvas. Printed picture book / screen print aesthetic, flat solid colour fills, bold even outlines with round joins, charming slight hand-drawn irregularity, not glossy. Extremely simple shapes readable at 74px. Centre complete character with about 8% margin, no cropping. No text, scenery, sparkles, gradients, blur, glow, 3D, airbrush, extra characters, or decorative props. Genuine alpha transparency. Hard offset shadow optional, no soft shadow. Neutral expression: facing viewer, two dark round dot eyes with tiny white highlights, small closed smile, flat circular coral cheeks.
